context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 verified the CCT (Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho) management feature. All backend endpoints work correctly: POST /api/clientes/{cliente_id}/convencao for upload with AI analysis, DELETE /api/clientes/{cliente_id}/convencao for removal, GET /api/dashboard/convencoes-vencimento for expiration alerts. The frontend has the CCT upload component integrated in the Empresas edit modal and the Validação de Rescisão wizard has the CCT step (step 3) that can use either uploaded CCT or CCT from cadastro. Note: The CCT widget on Dashboard only appears when there are CCTs expiring - currently no CCTs in the system so the widget is not visible.
